title: Black Holes and Scalar Propagation in Three-Dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet Gravity
summary: We derive an analytic black-hole family in three-dimensional scalar--tensor Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity with positive coupling. A single implicit equation determines the static circular metric and a scalar linear in time. We show that these solutions exhaust regular nonextremal exteriors with the stated AdS boundary conditions and a fixed nonzero coefficient of time in the scalar. The coupled metric and scalar perturbations have one propagating degree of freedom.
